programs.title: Enlighten Your Life
programs.desc: When we watch comedians on television, they often seem approachable and friendly. But have you ever wondered what their homes look like and how they're decorated? Today's theme is 'Comedians' Homes.'.

programs.title: Masterchef Australia
programs.desc: Contestants enter the kitchen to find legendary Australian chef Shannon Bennett. He is mid-cook, inspiring them with how much creativity and flavour can be packed into just twenty minutes.

programs.title: Masterchef Australia
programs.desc: It's the second elimination of the series and the contestants take part in the one-inch cube taste test, but with a twist: they are divided into three teams one nominated taste-tester for each team.

programs.title: Masterchef Australia
programs.desc: Today's Mystery Box challenge sees the contestants enter the Kitchen to find themselves facing the judges' four fridges, where they must select one and use whatever ingredients are inside to create a dish.

programs.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programs.desc: Rachael shows us how to make an impossibly delicious brunch menu of parm frittata with tomato sauce, served with a side of sausage and a simple salad that you can eat all day.

programs.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programs.sub_title: Grown Up Tomato Soup And Grilled Cheese
programs.desc: This classic childhood combo gets an adult makeover that will make your mouth water. Rachael shows us her version of creamy tomato soup and a spicy grilled cheese.

programs.title: 1,000 Ways To Dine
programs.desc: Have you ever wondered what it would be like to go back in time for a dining experience from a bygone era? In this episode, host Michael Yo transports viewers to a 1920s-style New York City speakeasy.

programs.title: Jason's Table: Masterful Dishes
programs.desc: Steamed Mud Crab With Glutinous Rice is a classic dish served in high-end Taiwanese restaurants. Chef Wu from A-Sha Restaurant, demonstrates the A-Sha version that has kept gourmets coming for 60 years.

programs.title: Jason's Table: Masterful Dishes
programs.desc: Chef Chen Zong-sheng demonstrates his delightfully deceptive dish: Carp-Shaped Giant Fried Prawns. As carp signifies fortune and prosperity, this dish is often served at weddings and celebrations.

programs.title: Global Soul Kitchen
programs.sub_title: Cajun Steak Diane With Foie Gras Dirty Rice
programs.desc: Chef Deborah VanTrece makes a soulful Southern twist on steak Diane, a pan-fried beef steak, by adding Cajun spices to the marinade and serving it with foie gras and Creole dirty rice.

programs.title: Enlighten Your Life
programs.desc: Today's theme is 'Gallery vs. Natural' interiors. We'll be showcasing homes that highlight the contrast between the bold gallery style and the serene natural aesthetic.

programs.title: My Husband's Other Wife
programs.desc: Young mother Kelli discovers that husband Ty is secretly married to another woman. Kelli threatens to file charges, but when Ty dies suddenly she suspects he's faked his death and is planning to kill her.
